title: Customer Satisfaction Survey – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains how Service NSW collects and uses your personal information when you complete a customer satisfaction survey.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of collecting my information?
faqs.a: The information is used to improve how Service NSW handles enquiries, communicate about your interactions, and for other directly related purposes.

faqs.q: What personal information will be collected?
faqs.a: Service NSW collects your full name, email address, and details about your interaction with Service NSW regarding your enquiry.

faqs.q: How will my information be used or disclosed?
faqs.a: Your information helps Service NSW continually improve customer support, allows them to communicate about your enquiry, and is used for reporting, research, and statistical purposes.
